newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George - Govt serious about low inflation.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George - Govt serious about low inflation.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Tuesday reforms to the monetary policy process announced by new Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown showed the government was serious about keeping inflation suppressed.
"It will convey to the economy at large including the financial markets that the government is really serious about keeping inflation low," George told ITN television news.
Earlier, Brown announced he would give the Bank operational independence to set interest rates and set up a new monetary policy committee, which will hold executive power.
The new monetary policy committee will comprise five Bank of England officials, including George, and four independent business and industry experts.
The Treasury has no vote on the committee and the Bank's inbuilt majority effectively gives it control of interest rates.
